I used to work in merchandising, selling finished goods to retailers. Previously I've worked in sourcing, connecting manufacturers to brands in the US.

Currently my business is an inventory financing solution for businesses who need supply chain financing.

What would you say the most major supply chain issues your organization has? Seems like a lot to be in charge of
